sanity_expectations: p_star is real-valued and finite over the whole sampling box
p_star lies within roughly [0, 1.05] (allowing rescue-tanh slight overshoot, minus isolation loss)
For fixed e, immigration_rate, suitable_habitat_fraction, p_star increases monotonically with c above the persistence region
For fixed c, immigration_rate, suitable_habitat_fraction, p_star decreases with e
As immigration_rate -> 0 with c*suitable_habitat_fraction <= e, p_star -> 0 (extinction below the colonization threshold)

p_star for the new (NB) form is strictly greater than p_star for the parent (exp) form at fixed inputs because (1+ed*p/dd)^(-dd) >= exp(-ed*p) for dd>0 and the isolation-loss term carries a minus sign
excitation_report: All three additive terms reach >= 5*sigma: baseline Levins-with-immigration root ~101.5x, rescue-tanh term ~6.03x, negative-binomial isolation-loss term ~5.79x. New term (NB^(-dd) minus parent's exp) peaks at ~5.28x sigma, strongest at c~1.73, e~0.47, immigration_rate~0.037, suitable_habitat_fraction~0.56 — well inside the sampled box.

c: V->V (confirmed independent sampling axis across landscapes, not a time coordinate — 'time-axis' tag is a mislabel, treated as a landscape parameter axis)
e: V->V (confirmed independent sampling axis, not a time coordinate)
immigration_rate: V->V (confirmed independent sampling axis, not a time coordinate)
suitable_habitat_fraction: V->V (confirmed independent sampling axis, not a time coordinate)
spatial_isolation_strength: P->P (confirmed fixed parameter; value raised to 1.5 vs. hint to make isolation-loss term visible above noise)
effective_donor_degree: P->P (confirmed fixed parameter; value 8 chosen so donor-neighborhood factor is moderate)
donor_degree_dispersion: P->P (confirmed fixed parameter; value 1 within the hinted 0<dd<=100 window, kept small so the NB kernel is distinguishable from parent's exp kernel)
rationale: Static explicit relation p_star = f(c, e, immigration_rate, suitable_habitat_fraction; 5 fixed parameters); no derivatives, no integrals, no target on the RHS, so integrator = evaluate_explicit. The four upstream 'time-axis' tags are actually independent landscape/rate variables, not a time coordinate; they are sampled over physically reasonable metapopulation ranges (c 0.2-2 /yr, e 0.05-0.5 /yr, immigration_rate 1e-3 to 1e-1 /yr, suitable_habitat_fraction 0.3-1). Fixed parameters chosen so the new negative-binomial donor-neighborhood factor is clearly distinguishable from the parent's plain exp (donor_degree_dispersion=1 sits at the strongly-heavy-tailed end of the hinted 0<dd<=100 range), and coefficients are tuned so every term — including the NB-vs-exp difference — reaches at least 5*sigma with sigma=0.005 on p_star (~1% of typical p_star ~0.5).
